entities.span: The core entities every later feature reads and writes: users, profile with skills and flat work history, stated job preferences, application records and their captured answers.
rejected_spans: A wrong data model is the most expensive thing to redo, so it is decided once, explicitly, before any feature depends on it.

entities.span: Search results deliberately do not persist.
**Done when:** the schema, keys, constraints and per user row level policies are applied and live,
a query as one user cannot return another user's rows,
and every value is stored raw with formatting left to render time.
Build it: `/develop data model` · landed in two pull requests, #9 the create and #10 the drop, both merged 2026-08-25. All sixteen acceptance criteria proved

The schema migration: the shared timestamp trigger, six tables with their checks and unique constraints, an explicit grant per table, and the twenty three policies (AC-1, AC-2, AC-4, AC-5, AC-6, AC-9 to AC-12)
Fixtures and types: the seed grows a profile for each of the two synthetic users plus a third carrying none, then `database.types.ts` is regenerated from the applied schema (AC-3, AC-14, AC-15)
The replacement read: `readOwnProfile()` with its named span and Zod parse, the span registered, the health page repointed off `scaffold_check` (AC-14, AC-15)

Proved against the real project: isolation both ways, the `with check` refusals, every constraint, the privilege check, and the preview confirmed as all three seeded users (AC-2 to AC-11, AC-14) · done 2026-08-25 on pull request #9. The sweep in verify.sql ran against the hosted development project with zero failures, and all three seeded users were driven through the preview page: dev-one and dev-two each saw only their own profile, dev-three saw the named `record_not_found` failure rather than an empty page

Expand then contract: merge, confirm production is serving the new read, and only then drop `scaffold_check` in a second pull request (AC-13, AC-16) · pull request #9 merged 2026-08-25, its production migration run succeeded and the production deployment built from that merge went live on `usejobhunt.vercel.app`. Only then was the drop written, in a second pull request. Pull request #10 then dropped it, merged 2026-08-25 as `3a56243`, its own production migration run succeeded, and `scaffold_check` now reads `gone` on local, development and production alike. AC-13 closed

Verify it: `/check verify data model` · all sixteen acceptance criteria proved fresh on 2026-08-25: local (`verify.sql`, 83/83 pass), the browser driven sign in states, and production (`verify-production.sql`, run directly by the engineer, all lines pass, `scaffold_check` confirmed gone)
